notes.title: Reactor upgrades Hotfix
notes.content: The reactor calibration and reactor yield drones can now be unlocked after unlocking the base reactor drone.

notes.title: Global Rank Hotfix
notes.content:
The global ranking screen has been fixed. New runs will now be uploaded to the leaderboard.
Your time is now! Go grab the top spot.

Other fixes of note:
[list]
[*]Steamdeck now chooses a reasonable input default
[*]Corrosive Wastes rebalanced
[*]Drone spawns improved in Corrosive Wastes & Ringed Pond
[/list]
and more incoming!

notes.title: Launch Date Announcement
notes.content: [p]This ship goes brrr will be available on steam 7/11/25.[/p][p]We've been hard at work since nextfest and have made many improvements, including:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added a new zone and enhanced the others[/p][/*][*][p]New musical tracks and sound overhaul[/p][/*][*][p]Added ui animations for ship abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked and balanced core gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Added 17 achievements[/p][/*][*][p]improved controller support[/p][/*][*][p]and more! [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Prepare to go brrr.[/p]
